name: GeDES FatTree48 wall-clock timing on one GB200

00.description: Time the public artifact workload with a 20-million-packet pool and verify completion of all 27,648 directed TCP flows, byte counts, and terminal queue drain.

01.name: GeDES FatTree48 10-second Nsight Systems profile
01.description: Capture 10 wall-clock seconds from the start of the pinned FT48 simulation loop on one GB200, including CUDA graph nodes, SMs Active, SM Issue and DRAM activity. Require a native report no larger than 64 MiB. Continue to terminal drain and compare with an unprofiled run of the same binary. Export the trace even when paired FCT differs.

02.name: GeDES FatTree48 full warp lifetime trace
02.description: Trace every warp of all 45 kernel launches per FT48 timeslot through terminal drain on one GB200. Validate coverage, matched inputs and terminal byte/queue state. Report per-flow completion-time differences separately.
